name: Tragic Banshee — "A creature died this turn" toggle at No: -1/-1
notes: Memory: project_asked_condition_toggles_2026-10-11. "… gets -1/-1 until end of turn. If a creature died this turn, that creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn instead." Whether a creature died cannot be read off the board, so the fired ability has a toggle with that label: No gives -1/-1, Yes gives -13/-13 in its place. Both share the one target.
